children: Dell Technologies' upgrade to its fiscal 2027 revenue outlook is driven by momentum in AI and more resilient-than-feared demand for its computers, JPMorgan analysts write. Dell's order backlog of $95 billion supports a sharp rise in its AI-server revenue outlook to $74 billion for the fiscal year, the analysts say. Elsewhere, the company's traditional infrastructure business remains strong, they say. "The net result is demand tailwinds compounding across multiple vectors at once, paired with Dell's best-in-class execution." JPMorgan ups its price target for Dell from $565 a share to $635. Shares jump 9.4% premarket. (josephmichael.stonor@wsj.com)
